# Integration Verification — Init Status
exec akb --version
stdout 'akb (dev|0\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+)'

exec akb init test-kb
stdout 'Initialized KB "test-kb"'

cd test-kb

exists kb
exists raw
exists .akb
exists .akb/templates

exists kb/index.md
exists kb/log.md
exists raw/files.log

exists .akb/.akb.yaml

# init seeds no templates: the directory is created empty.
exec ls -A .akb/templates
stdout ''
! exists .akb/templates/note.yaml
! exists .akb/templates/adr.yaml

exec akb template list
stdout 'No templates found'

# A typed page is refused until a template exists for its type.
stdin ../unknown-note.md
! exec akb write notes/first.md
stderr 'unknown type .note.'
stderr 'Author .akb/templates/note.yaml'
stderr 'akb template list --examples'
! exists kb/notes/first.md

exists .akb/search.db

exists .akb/.gitignore
exists .gitignore

grep 'search\.db' .akb/.gitignore
grep '\.akb\.bak' .gitignore

exec git log --oneline
stdout 'akb: init test-kb'

exec akb status
stdout 'Name: test-kb'
stdout 'Pages: 0'
stdout 'Git: clean'

-- unknown-note.md --
---
type: note
title: First note
---

# First note

A note the KB refuses until it has a note template.
